PLUGIN_FAMILY_WORDS.doc: A family a CLAP plugin feature or LV2 plugin class maps onto (its `word`, docs/data-layout.md) when it is not one of the four `plugin.features` words: no consumer reads these yet (FreeMixer/omx-contract#120).

ambisonic.doc: A plugin whose audio capability is ambisonic, a CLAP Audio Capability with no LV2 or ports.layout match.

generator.doc: A plugin that produces a signal with no note or audio input: neither an instrument (no notes in) nor an audio-effect (no audio in).

mono.doc: A plugin whose audio capability is mono, a CLAP Audio Capability distinct from a port's own `layout`.

noteDetector.doc: A plugin that converts audio to notes, CLAP's mirror of note-effect; no plugin.features word names it.

plugin.doc: LV2's base plugin class: every LV2 plugin is one, so it names no specific kind.

stereo.doc: A plugin whose audio capability is stereo, a CLAP Audio Capability distinct from a port's own `layout`.

surround.doc: A plugin whose audio capability is surround, a CLAP Audio Capability distinct from a port's own `layout`.
